authority_statement: Informational report only; the deterministic LFighter pipeline retains all security decision authority.
executive_summary: In the reported condition, the defended DDoS-to-Benign rate was lower than the plain attack rate; reconstruction reduced normalized attribution distance relative to the paired reference.

facts.statement: The plain attack mean DDoS-to-Benign prediction rate was 0.150305, versus 0.049047 in the paired clean branch.
The defended mean DDoS-to-Benign prediction rate was 0.071027, an absolute reduction of 0.079278 from the plain attack branch.
Mean and minimum malicious recall were 1.000000, and maximum benign false-positive rate was 0.000000.
Normalized attribution distance decreased from 0.673945 to 0.386858, with recovery fraction 0.425979.

interpretations.statement: Observed prediction behavior is consistent with targeted suppression of DDoS predictions toward Benign, but does not establish malicious intent.
Reconstruction moved the attribution profile toward its paired preattack clean reference; this is not evidence of oracle clean restoration.

refusals: No conclusion of malicious intent is made; verified malicious intent is unsupported.
No claim of oracle clean recovery is made; exact oracle clean recovery is unsupported.
uncertainties: The clean attribution comparator was the paired round 4 preattack reference, not an oracle clean state.
Rejected and oracle-clean attribution states were unavailable.
Per-client detector scores and numeric detector thresholds were not materialized.
Evidence was limited to development and validation; reserved test arrays remained closed.
